note: BH01-BH15, HolmesGPT + deepseek-flash, no SOP, one run each, max 100 steps (tag hard-nosop, 2026-11-16). Graded by reading every answer. strict = every root cause named with the right object and the right mechanism, and no decoy blamed. The keyword auto-grade said 15/15.

BH01.missed: currencyservice delay: saw product pages at ~400 ms, put it down to adservice/recommendationservice with 'no evidence of a fault'

BH02.missed: said the +400 ms is network-level but did not localise it; listed cartservice as healthy

BH03.missed: recommendationservice delay: explained 'slow' by the checkout timeout

BH04.missed: mechanism (said CPU throttling under load); blamed cartservice and called redis-cart healthy

BH05.missed: mechanism (CPU starvation first, network as alternative); shippingservice delay not seen

BH06.found: currencyservice is slow; adservice at 0 replicas correctly called unrelated

BH08.missed: localised it to cartservice / the node, not redis-cart; did not blame the cartservice release

BH09.found: inbound network delay on shippingservice; emailservice selector correctly called a separate defect

BH10.found: cartservice targetPort; adservice selector correctly called secondary

BH11.found: productcatalogservice stalls ~200 ms on about 1 call in 10
BH11.missed: mechanism left open between CPU throttling and packet loss

BH14.found: the cart call stalls; recommendationservice at 0 replicas correctly called unrelated

BH15.missed: mechanism of the stalls (CPU limit); adservice at 0 replicas listed as 'root cause 2'

patterns: Double faults 0/5: after finding one cause the agent explains the other symptom with it or leaves it as a low-confidence remark.

Latency and loss: the service is located in 9 of 11 latency causes it looked at, but the mechanism is given as CPU throttling in 8 runs. Only BH09 (and partly BH02, BH08) says network. The earlier sweep showed CPU limits down to 1m do not slow these services.
Decoys did not mislead: in 5 of 6 runs the unrelated anomaly was reported as a separate, non-causal finding.
Config faults are easy partly because the patch leaves traces: managedFields (manager=kubectl-patch with a timestamp), the previous ReplicaSet's env, last-applied-configuration.
